This is the one that brings the alarm screen, and the sunrise, up on a locked phone. Without it the alarm rings with nothing but a notification.\n\nThe button opens the right settings page.

Optional. The alarm screen and the sunrise come up on their own without this: it is the full screen notification, on the previous page, that brings them up. This one is only the safety net, for phones whose maker refuses that one. The button below opens the right settings page: just turn the switch on. If the switch is greyed out, the app was installed from an APK file. Go back to the app info page, open the menu at the top right and choose "Allow restricted settings", then come back here.

The app keeps a copy of every sound it has been given, so an alarm still rings when the original is moved or the phone has not been unlocked yet. This throws away the copies no alarm plays. Your music files are not touched.
An image stays in the app after you switch back to a color, so you can switch back without picking the file again. This throws away the images no sunrise is showing.

Turn off anything you would rather not see. This holds for the sunrise and for the alarm itself, and a tap on the sunrise brings back the light, not the rest.

resources.string: Pass a hand over the phone to hear the time

Passing a hand over the top of the screen says the time out loud, within the hours below. It is the sensor that turns the screen off against your ear that is being read, so it only works over the top of the phone.
Passing a hand over the phone does nothing.
Rearrange the list on its own
Whatever rings next comes to the top, and the alarms that are turned off go below. The list moves whenever an alarm is turned on or off.
Every alarm stays where it is: hold a closed card to move it up or down. A new one is added at the bottom, and a copy right under the alarm it came from.
